description_en: Retrieves the Real User Monitoring exception stack trace
name: GetRumExceptionStack

parameters.help_en: The error stack trace in JSON list format. Each list element includes the call_stack.info, call_stack.thread.name, and call_stack.thread.id fields, which represent the stack trace, thread name, and thread ID, respectively. This is exactly the same as the exception.stack field in the logstore-rum Logstore of Simple Log Service
parameters.help_zh: 错误堆栈信息，JSON列表格式，列表元素包括call_stack.info、call_stack.thread.name和call_stack.thread.id三个字段，分别代表堆栈信息、线程名称和线程id，同SLS的logstore-rum中的exception.stack字段完全一致
parameters.name: exception_stack

parameters.help_en: The binary images, which represent all executable files loaded into the process address space at the time of the crash
parameters.help_zh: Binary Images，表示在崩溃时装载到进程地址空间的所有可执行文件
parameters.name: exception_binary_images

parameters.help_en: The ID of the exception thread
parameters.name: exception_thread_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the parsing type. Valid values:
js: JavaScript error parsing
sym: PC client parsing
har: HarmonyOS client parsing
dSYM: iOS client parsing
so: Android client parsing
parameters.help_zh:
指定解析类型
js：JS 错误解析
sym：PC 端解析
har：鸿蒙端解析
dSYM： iOS 端解析
so: 安卓端解析
parameters.name: sourcemap_type

parameters.help_en: The additional system symbol table information for iOS client parsing. This parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh: 在 iOS 端解析额外的系统符号表信息，用户可不填
parameters.name: extra_info

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

BinaryImages.description_en: The names and UUIDs of the system symbol tables required for parsing the exception stack trace. This field is returned only for PC client parsing
BinaryImages.description_zh: PC 端解析会透出，解析异常堆栈所需的系统符号表的名字与 UUID

CrashAddress.description_en: The crash address. This field is returned only for PC client parsing
CrashAddress.description_zh: PC端解析时会透出，崩溃地址

CrashReason.description_en: The cause of the exception. This field is returned only for PC client parsing
CrashReason.description_zh: PC端解析时会透出，异常原因

items.description_zh: 解析后的错误堆栈信息

ModuleName.description_en: The name of the crash parsing module. This field is returned only for PC client parsing
ModuleName.description_zh: PC 端解析时会透出，崩溃解析模块名

ThreadInfoList.description_en: The details of the captured thread stack traces for PC client crashes
ThreadInfoList.description_zh: PC 端崩溃，抓取的线程堆栈详情

ThreadTag.description_en: The thread tag, which includes the thread number and thread name
ThreadTag.description_zh: 线程标签（包含线程号和线程名）

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the symbol table required for stack trace parsing. This field is returned only for PC client parsing
Uuid.description_zh: PC 端解析会透出，解析堆栈所需符号表的 UUID

Message.description_en: The message returned when the call fails
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的信息
Message.example: 内部错误，请联系管理员。

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The operation was successful.
false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

`true`：操作成功
`false`：操作失败
